Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

constructor.custom:error: Throws ZeroAddressNotAllowed if the CorePoolComptroller or RiskStewardReceiver addresses are zero
constructor.details: Sets the immutable CorePoolComptroller and RiskStewardReceiver addresses and disables initializers

initialize(address,uint256,uint256).custom:error: Throws InvalidMaxDeltaBps if the max delta bps is 0 or greater than MAX_BPS
initialize(address,uint256,uint256).details: Initializes the contract as ownable, access controlled, and pausable. Sets the max delta bps initial value.

params.accessControlManager_: The address of the access control manager

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

processUpdate(uint256,bytes,string,addre.custom:error: UnsupportedUpdateType Thrown if the update type is not supportedUpdateNotInRange Thrown if the update is not within the allowed range
processUpdate(uint256,bytes,string,addre.custom:event: Emits CollateralFactorUpdated or LiquidationThresholdUpdated depending on the update with the market and new cap

params.market: The market to update the newValue for

setAccessControlManager(address).details: Admin function to set address of AccessControlManager

params.accessControlManager_: The new address of the AccessControlManager

setDebouncePeriod(uint256).custom:error: InvalidDebouncePeriod if the debounce period is 0 or less than the RiskStewardReceiver's UPDATE_EXPIRATION_TIME
setDebouncePeriod(uint256).custom:event: Emits DebouncePeriodUpdated with the old and new debounce period

setMaxDeltaBps(uint256).custom:error: InvalidMaxDeltaBps if the max delta bps is 0 or greater than MAX_BPS
setMaxDeltaBps(uint256).custom:event: Emits MaxDeltaBpsUpdated with the old and new max delta bps

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

InvalidDebouncePeriod().notice: Thrown when a debounce period of 0 is set

InvalidMaxDeltaBps().notice: Thrown when a maxDeltaBps value of 0 is set

Unauthorized(address,address,string).notice: Thrown when the action is prohibited by AccessControlManager

UnsupportedUpdateType(uint256).notice: Thrown when an updateType that is not supported is operated on

UpdateAlreadyProcessed(uint256).notice: Thrown when update is already processed

UpdateNotInRange(uint256).notice: Thrown when the new value of an update is out of range

UpdateTooFrequent().notice: Thrown when the debounce period hasn't passed for applying an update to a specific market/ update type

ZeroAddressNotAllowed().notice: Thrown if the supplied address is a zero address where it is not allowed

CollateralFactorUpdated(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when a collateralFactor is updated

DebouncePeriodUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when the debounce period is updated

LiquidationThresholdUpdated(address,uint.notice: Emitted when a liquidationThreshold is updated

MaxDeltaBpsUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when the max delta bps is updated

NewAccessControlManager(address,address).notice: Emitted when access control manager contract address is changed

CORE_POOL_COMPTROLLER().notice: Address of the CorePoolComptroller used for selecting the correct comptroller abi

LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD().notice: The update type for liquidation threshold

RISK_STEWARD_RECEIVER().notice: Address of the RiskStewardReceiver used to validate incoming updates

accessControlManager().notice: Returns the address of the access control manager contract

debouncePeriod().notice: The debounce period for updates in seconds

lastProcessedTime(bytes).notice: Mapping of market and update type to last update timestamp. Used for debouncing updates.

maxDeltaBps().notice: The max delta bps for the update relative to the current value

packNewValue(bytes).notice: Packs the new value into a bytes memory

processUpdate(uint256,bytes,string,addre.notice: Processes a market cap update from the RiskStewardReceiver. Validates that the update is within range and then directly update the market collateralFactor or liquidationThreshold on the market's comptroller.

processedUpdates(uint256).notice: Mapping of processed updates. Used to prevent re-execution

userdoc.notice: Contract that can update collateralFactor and liquidationThreshold received from RiskStewardReceiver. Requires that the update is within the max delta. Expects the new value to be an encoded uint256 value of un padded bytes.
